#ifndef X_H
#define X_H
#define INLINE inline __attribute__(( always_inline ))
#define ROUND(x) do { volatile float slot_ = (x); (x) = slot_; } while (0)
#define WAIT(f) do { while (!ready(f)) { } } while (0)
#define ASM(x) __asm__("" : "+w"(x))
#define ZERO(...) ((void)sizeof(struct { int bad : -1; }))
#   define  A   ( 1+2 )
#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif
enum { kA=1, kB=2 };
typedef enum Mode { MODE_NONE=0,
  MODE_ONE = 1 } Mode;
typedef struct Thing {
    int a; /* first */
    const char* name;
    uint8_t **rows;
    int64_t (*storage)(const struct Thing*);
} Thing;
typedef uint64_t (*id_fn_t)(uint32_t ordinal);
static const uint8_t bytes[] = {
    0x01, 0x02,
    0x03 };
static const uint64_t ids[] = { UINT64_C(0x1), UINT64_C(0x2), };
static const Row rows[] = {
    { 0, 0 }, /* Root */
    { 4, (uint32_t)offsetof(Thing, a) }, /* a */
};
static int empty(void) {}
static int one(Thing* t) { return t->a; }
static SCHEMA_UNUSED int f(const Thing *t, int *hi, uint8_t* out, int64_t n)
{
    int i, k; uint32_t raw[3] = {0};
    if (t == NULL) return -1;
    if (n < 0) { return -2; }
    if (n > 4) { hi[0] = 1; return 2; }
    if (t->a) *hi = (int64_t)*out < 0 ? UINT64_MAX : 0;
    if (t->name == NULL) (*hi) = 3;
    for (k = 0; k < 3; k++) for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) raw[k] |= (uint32_t)out[4*k+i] << (8*i);
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) /* every byte */
    {
        out[i] = (uint8_t)(i & 0xff);
    }
    while (n-- > 0) ;
    do { i++; } while (i < 10);
    switch (t->a) {
    case 1: return 1;
    case UINT64_C(0x2): { i = -i; } break;
    case 3:
        i = ~i; k = !i;
        break;
    default: break;
    }
    if (i) goto done;
    out[t->rows[idx(t, k)]] = 0;
    i = t->a ? 1 : (k ? 2 : 3);
    return i;
done: return sizeof(*t) + sizeof(Thing);
}
#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
#endif
